notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
[b]Updates :[/b]
[list]
[*] Buildings can [b]no longer debuff if the player had not received their buff in the first place[/b]
[*] Ranged enemies will now[b] update their attack[/b] if an unit comes closer
[*] Added a tutorial page about [b]Traits and Experience Points[/b]
[/list]
